xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4247: Messages sent to a Claude Code conversation while a subagent is running land in the subagent, and the dashboard shows 'Sent · waiting for transcript' forever

plan.title: Messages sent to a Claude Code conversation while a subagent is running land in the subagent, and the dashboard shows 'Sent · waiting for transcript' forever
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One operator-visible defect (input silently lost to a subagent) spans the delivery chain: the shared sidechain reader in src/lib/transcript-landing.ts feeds both the pan tell confirmation and the dashboard subagent list, so the two halves are not independently shippable without duplicating that reader. The lint counts 8 path groups (src/lib, src/cli, src/dashboard, packages/contracts, tests/unit, scripts, and two docs files) and 29 files, of which 13 are named test files or the file-size allowlist. Items are small, DAG-ordered, and each has its own test command.

narratives.Problem: When a Claude Code conversation has a background subagent, typed input (dashboard composer or pan tell) can be routed by Claude Code into the subagent sidechain. The main transcript never shows it, the dashboard bubble stays 'Sent · waiting for transcript' forever, and pan tell reports 'turn confirmed' because any assistant record in the main transcript (here a reaction to the subagent's task-notification) counts as confirmation. Separately, two quick sends can be joined by Claude Code into one queued message that matches neither bubble, and accepted bubbles that never match have no timeout.
narratives.Proposal: Teach transcript confirmation to read main queue records, to ignore assistant turns caused by task-notification wakes, and to probe subagent sidechains for human-origin records (landing kind main/subagent/none; no redelivery into a subagent; pan tell exits 1 naming the subagent). Surface each subagent's recent human inputs and background flag on SubagentSummary via an incremental scanner. In the composer, relabel bubbles that landed in a subagent, clear bubbles joined into one message, move long-unmatched accepted bubbles (only while not streaming) to a 'Not found in transcript' outbox with Resend (fresh identity) and Copy, and show a routed/running subagent notice with a Send anyway / Wait confirmation for the evidence-based case. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4247.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing pane injection (PTY supervisor, tmux, Herdr) to stop Claude Code from joining queued messages
- Sending keystrokes to move Claude Code's input focus back from a subagent to the main agent
- Direct composer input to Claude Code subagents (the direct child composer stays Codex-only)
- Making the eaten-message watcher (conversation-eaten-message-watcher.ts) sidechain-aware
- Rendering sidechain human inputs as permanent rows in the parent conversation timeline
- Persisting any delivery status in a database or state file
- Non-claude-code harnesses
- Updating the OKF bundle (../overdeck-knowledge) inside this PR

autoDecisions.summary: Joined messages are fixed by reconciliation only; injection is unchanged
autoDecisions.rationale: The composer already serializes sends per conversation and the transcript shows one Claude Code enqueue with the combined text, so the join mechanism is inside Claude Code and cannot be named from evidence. Matching the concatenation clears the bubbles without guessing.

autoDecisions.summary: pan tell treats a subagent landing as not delivered (exit 1, mail kind 'queued', no second attempt)
autoDecisions.rationale: The caller's intent was to reach the main agent; a retry would land in the subagent again, and 'queued' keeps the text for manual delivery.

autoDecisions.summary: Human sidechain inputs travel on the existing SubagentSummary (background, humanInputs) instead of a new ConversationEvent kind
autoDecisions.rationale: The 2 s subagent poll already emits change-only lists on both the live stream and the one-shot GET, so no new transport or contract kind is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: The 'running background subagent' notice is hedged ('may route') and informational; only the evidence-based 'routed' notice asks Send anyway / Wait
autoDecisions.rationale: The evidence proves routing only after the fact; Claude Code's exact routing rule is not established, so blocking on a mere running subagent would produce false alarms.

autoDecisions.summary: Unmatched accepted bubbles move to the outbox after TURN_STALL_MS (4 min) only while the conversation is not streaming
autoDecisions.rationale: A message queued behind a long tool call is legitimately unrendered until consumed; gating on streaming avoids false 'not found' labels and duplicate resends.

autoDecisions.summary: Sidechain matching uses whitespace-normalized includes, and each subagent keeps at most 20 inputs of 2000 characters
autoDecisions.rationale: Delivered text can carry @attachment prefixes or envelopes; the caps bound payload size while covering realistic sends.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan kept as one issue with sizeJustification instead of sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The pan tell and dashboard halves share the sidechain reader built in the first item and together fix one operator-visible defect; the file count is inflated by per-item test files.

items.title: Landing probe: match main queue records, skip task-notification wakes, probe subagent sidechains

expected_outputs: transcript-landing.test.ts passes including the new queue-operation, queued_command, task-notification and sidechain cases

narrative.Action:
Implement PRD work item W1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4247.md) in src/lib/transcript-landing.ts. (1) In probeTranscriptSince add queuedPromptText(): a queue-operation record with operation 'enqueue' and string content, or an attachment record with attachment.type 'queued_command' and string prompt, whose normalized text includes the 120-char needle sets matchedUserRecord=true; queued text starting with '<task-notification>' never matches. (2) Track afterTaskNotification while scanning: a user record whose text starts with '<task-notification>' sets it true, any other landed user record sets it false; real assistant records increment realAssistantTurnCount only when afterTaskNotification is false. (3) Export extractSidechainHumanText(content) (strip leading 'The user sent a new message while you were working:
', cut at first '

This is how Claude Code surfaces', trim; raw trimmed text if prefix absent), interface SidechainHumanInput {id,text,createdAt}, readSidechainHumanInputs(file, fromByteOffset) returning {inputs, readOffset} over complete lines only, keeping records with type 'user' AND isSidechain true AND origin.kind 'human'; captureSidechainOffsets(sessionFile) mapping each subagents/agent-*.jsonl to its size (empty map if dir missing); probeSidechainsSince(sessionFile, offsets, messageText) returning {agentId, description} for the first human input whose normalized text includes the needle (files absent from offsets start at 0; agentId from filename; description from agent-<id>.meta.json, fallback agentId), else null. Compute the subagents dir as join(sessionFile.replace(/\.jsonl$/, ''), 'subagents'); do NOT import from src/dashboard. Async fs only. Add the tests listed in W1 step 4 using temp JSONL files.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD work item W9. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/subagentRouting.ts exporting type SubagentRoutingNotice ({kind:'routed'|'running'; key; agentId; description} | null) and subagentRoutingNotice(subagents, messages): 'routed' when the newest humanInputs entry across subagents is newer than the newest role 'user' message whose id does not start with 'optimistic-' AND whose text does not start with '<task-notification>' (subagent relays land such records in main and must not clear the notice; key = input.id); else 'running' for the first subagent with background true and status 'running' (key = agentId); else null. ConversationPanel.tsx computes it from data?.subagents and serverMessages and passes subagentNotice to <ComposerFooter> (allowlist row if the file grows past its origin/main count). ComposerFooter renders the notice above the input. routed text: `Your last message went to subagent "<description>", not this conversation. New messages may go there too.`; while an unconfirmed routed key is shown, handleSubmit does not send but sets confirmPending and shows buttons 'Send anyway' (records the key as confirmed, then submits) and 'Wait' (clears confirmPending, keeps the draft). running text: `Background subagent "<description>" is running. Claude Code may route typed messages to it.` — informational only, never blocks sending.
